# Health Flare

> A calm, private health journal for people living with chronic illness, and the people who
> care for them. Offline-first Flutter/Dart app for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and
> web. No accounts, no cloud sync, no server of ours.

Log symptoms, vitals, medications, meals, and journal entries in one place, then export a PDF
or CSV before a medical appointment. One install can track more than one person (self, a
child, a parent), each with separate data. Built with Flutter, Riverpod for state management,
and Isar Community for local storage.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what the app does, screenshots, store links
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): full architecture and developer/agent reference — read this before
  making non-trivial changes
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute code, and the ground rules
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): index of everything else under `docs/`

## Rules that apply to any change, human or agent

- **Offline-first.** No new network calls, analytics, or telemetry. The one documented
  exception is opt-in weather capture (approximate location only, never stored — see
  `CLAUDE.md`).
- **Feature files are the spec.** Behavior lives in `docs/features/*.feature` (Gherkin) before
  it's built. Update the relevant `.feature` file as part of a behavior change, not after.
- **Privacy copy is precise.** Never say data "never leaves the device" — OS backups
  (iCloud/Google) include it, by design. `test/unit/privacy_claims_test.dart` enforces this.

## Not the source of truth

`docs/archive/` holds superseded planning docs, kept for history only. Don't treat anything
there as current behavior or policy.
